name: Showcase the four TypeSafe Jev actions on a product review
description: A small showcase of the TypeSafe AI component: one product review goes through each Jev action in turn. Noul answers a yes/no question with a truth value, Choice picks one label with probabilities and a confidence, Score places the review on a star rubric, and Ask Questions answers all three in a single call. Only a TypeSafe AI connection is needed; run it with Test and compare the outputs.
shortDescription: Run one product review through the Noul, Choice, Score and Ask Questions actions of TypeSafe Jev.
keyFeatures: Noul: a yes/no answer as a truth value, with isTrue against a threshold
Choice: one label from a fixed set, with probabilities and a confidence
Score: a position on an ordered rubric, with the nearest level's label
Ask Questions: all three typed questions about the same text in one call
prerequisites: A TypeSafe AI API key (https://typesafe.ai) in a TypeSafe AI connection, or a self-hosted System One server such as Laya on Ollama
idealFor: Anyone who wants to see what each TypeSafe Jev action returns before building it into a larger workflow.
steps: Trigger: run the workflow manually with a product review as input.
Noul: ask whether the review is positive.
Choice: ask what the review is mainly about.
Score: ask how many stars the customer would give.
Ask Questions: ask all three questions in one call.
